commands: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test -d "$P/.git"; test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)"; ORIGIN=$(git -C "$P" remote get-url origin); case "$ORIGIN" in https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller|https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|git@github.com:MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git) ;; *) echo BOUND_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 42;; esac; echo BEFORE_HEAD=$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD); echo BEFORE_BRANCH=$(git -C "$P" branch --show-current)

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; git -C "$P" fetch --prune origin; git -C "$P" switch main; git -C "$P" merge --ff-only origin/main; test "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)" = "a07b5a14f4bb3ab8b8ca866aafb52a1390ef69ab"; test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)"; echo LOCAL_MAIN_SYNCED=$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; echo '=== LOCAL BRANCHES ==='; git -C "$P" for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)|%(committerdate:iso8601)|%(upstream:short)|%(upstream:track)' refs/heads; echo '=== LOCAL MERGED INTO MAIN ==='; git -C "$P" branch --merged main; echo '=== LOCAL UNMERGED INTO MAIN ==='; git -C "$P" branch --no-merged main

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; echo '=== REMOTE BRANCHES ==='; git -C "$P" for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)|%(committerdate:iso8601)' refs/remotes/origin; echo '=== REMOTE MERGED INTO ORIGIN/MAIN ==='; git -C "$P" branch -r --merged origin/main; echo '=== REMOTE UNMERGED INTO ORIGIN/MAIN ==='; git -C "$P" branch -r --no-merged origin/main

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; echo '=== FINAL STATUS ==='; git -C "$P" status --short --branch; echo '=== FINAL TOP CLIMATE ==='; git -C "$P" ls-files 'src/climate/*' | awk -F/ 'NF==3{print}' | sort
